title: Exercises
description: The exercise library. Each entry is one exercise the coach can put in a workout. The order in the file is the order the app lists them in.

id.description: Stable short id. Workout history refers to it, so never change or reuse one that has shipped.

name.description: Name shown in the app, in sentence case.

pattern.description: Movement pattern: squat, hinge, single (single-leg), hpush/vpush (horizontal/vertical push), hpull/vpull (horizontal/vertical pull), carry (carry & grip), core, power (power & jumps), arms, calves (calves & shins), shoulder (shoulder health), cond (conditioning), mob (mobility).

muscles.description: Muscles worked. The first one is the primary muscle.

equipment.description: Ways to do it. Each option lists everything it needs (ids from equipment.json); [] means no equipment. The app picks the first option the person has.

tracking.description: What gets logged for each set.

figure.description: Id of the drawing in figures.json that shows this exercise. Exercises without one get a drawing for their movement pattern.

qualities.description: Athletic qualities it builds, used to match sports: power, single (single-leg strength), lat (lateral movement), rot (rotation), grip, endur (endurance), mob (mobility), core (trunk stability), post (posterior chain), shoulder (shoulder resilience).

startWeight.description: For weighted exercises without a strongRatio: a sensible first-session weight in kg (per hand when perHand is true), used until the person has history. Exercises with a strongRatio get a starting weight from their bodyweight instead.

strongRatio.description: Estimated max divided by bodyweight that counts as strong (a score of 100). Leave out if the exercise isn't scored.

bodyweightShare.description: Share of bodyweight moved in each rep, for bodyweight and loaded single-leg moves.

perHand.description: true when the logged weight is per hand (dumbbells, kettlebells).

mainLift.description: true for big compound lifts the coach builds a session around.

strongReps.description: For bodyweight reps: reps that count as strong.

strongSeconds.description: For timed holds and carries: seconds that count as strong.

armFocus.description: For arm exercises: which side of the arm it trains, so sessions balance the two.

cues.description: Short coaching cues shown during the set, most important first.
